podcast.title: Invented Collaboration Group
podcast.body: Space Monkeyz was not a traditional band but an entity invented by Damon Albarn and his friends specifically for their collaboration with Gorillaz on the "Laika Come Home" album. They focused on creating music with Caribbean, African, and Rige rhythms. "Space Monkage no existe Es un grupo que se inventó también Daemon Alban con unos amigos que hacían música caribeña, africana y de ritmos Rige con el que hizo este disco."

srcs.episode: Los discos menos conocidos de Damon Albarn (Gorillaz y Blur)

podcast.title: One-Time Project
podcast.body: Space Monkeyz was a one-off project that only existed for its collaboration with Gorillaz on "Laika Come Home" and did not continue to create music thereafter. "no volvieron a existir nunca más."
